name: Iron Abyss
look: a Manaphy of glassy cyan jelly with yellow-rimmed grid lens eyes, a red chest gem, white circuit fins and two long antennae flowing down to glowing balls, before a faint rainbow ring
entry: A Pokémon resembling Manaphy, recorded in a report about a jelly-like probe that drifted up from the deepest trench. Anyone it meets feels as though they have known it all their life.
how: Wild: very rare by day in deep oceans.
